v01.text: In Hollow Creek, nothing ever happened.

v02.text: Every night was quiet. Every road was empty.

v03.text: Until the night a light appeared above the trees.

v04.text: And at exactly three seventeen A.M.

v05.text: every clock in town stopped. For one hour.

v06.text: Four hundred and twelve people vanished from their homes.

v07.text: When the hour ended, they came back. Exactly where they'd been.

v08.text: But something came back with them.

v09.text: Doctors found nothing. Police found nothing.

v10.text: And no one can remember where they went.
